description: A short rigid blade set in a handle, designed for slicing card and paper cleanly against a straight-edge. The shape lets the worker bear down on the guide while keeping a controlled, shallow cut.
name: mount-cutter's knife

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter III, p.53. Internet Archive.
